mentions.name: StatusDrift
mentions.description: This app provides uptime, certificate, domain, DNS, and TCP monitoring together with status pages, incident management, SLA monitoring, and on-call scheduling in a single tool. It uses a flat monthly rate with no per-check credits and includes a free tier for commercial or hobby use.
mentions.problem: Established monitoring and ITSM tools have stagnated, impose artificial limits or credit systems, and split incident management and status pages into separate products; ServiceNow on-call is slow and complex for simple schedules, and Uptime Kuma lacks features for smaller teams or agencies.
mentions.audience: smaller teams or agencies; free tier for commercial or hobby use
